_doc: fl_doctor / fl_review 'silent_knob': which plugin parameters set how loud an instrument plays. Words are matched (case-insensitive, camelCase and separators split) against each plugin's OWN parameter names - no plugin or vendor list. level_words at silence = practically silent (high); weak_words at 0 = a hint (some plugins read 0 as 'no velocity response'); a name holding any not_level_words is never judged. midi_cc: MIDI-standard controllers a saved JUCE-style state maps a parameter to. Override or extend in <state folder>/doctor/level_params.json (lists add, dicts / numbers override).
